description.en: The ID of the Public DNS configuration.

description.zh:
查询的结束时间（时间戳，单位：毫秒）。
><warning>如果查询时间段跨度较大，查询域名的解析日志量过多，可能会导致查询超时或者查询结果不准确。></warning>
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
><warning>If you specify a wide time range, many logs may be returned. This can cause a query timeout or inaccurate results.></warning>

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en.

description.zh:
模块类型
- AUTHORITY（默认值）：公网权威DNS
- RECURSION：公网递归DNS
description.en:
The module type.

- AUTHORITY (default): public authoritative DNS

- RECURSION: public recursive DNS
The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh:
查询参数
- sourceIp：源IP地址
- queryNameFuzzy：域名（模糊值）
- queryType：记录类型
- value：解析结果
- status：状态
- serverIp：解析服务器IP
description.en:
The query parameters.

- sourceIp: the source IP address

- queryNameFuzzy: the domain name (fuzzy match)

- queryType: the record type

- value: the resolution result

- status: the status

- serverIp: the IP address of the resolution server

description.zh: 查询的开始时间（时间戳，单位：毫秒）。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-internet-dns-logs --lang en --start-timestamp 1738848000000 --end-timestamp 1741526400000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --module AUTHORITY --query-condition sourceIp_:_59.82.XX.XX_,_queryType_:_A --domain-name www.example.com --account-id 51004 --recursion-protocol-type example-string --precise-sort true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeInternetDnsLogs --region cn-hangzhou --AccountId 51004 --PageSize 10 --StartTimestamp 1738848000000 --PageNumber 1 --DomainName 'www.example.com' --Lang en --EndTimestamp 1741526400000 --RecursionProtocolType 'example-string' --PreciseSort true --Module AUTHORITY --QueryCondition 'sourceIp_:_59.82.XX.XX_,_queryType_:_A'
